errors.text: The hypothesis places L12-type ordering or precipitates primarily within the B2 phase, whereas the target mechanism requires enhanced L12 ordering in FCC domains approaching Ni3Al stoichiometry.
It omits the key role of jagged B2/FCC phase-boundary tips as stress concentrators that couple with planar slip to trigger plastic instability.
The proposed 400–600°C brittle window conflicts with the target boundary of approximately 550–750°C, including maximum embrittlement near 600°C and recovery near 750°C.

The claimed prior evidence does not substantiate restricted cross-slip or planar slip in ordered domains; the cited records mainly establish the alloy's FCC/B2 microstructure and baseline mechanical properties.
